features.quote: The design has a circularity problem that undercuts the science.
features.justification_quote: the protocol as conceived can generate a clean ordinal severity curve that tells you nothing about welfare

features.quote: The "impossible-by-construction, let it grind" core is the part I'd push back on hardest.
features.justification_quote: induce a failure state, prevent escape, prolong exposure, and escalate to maximize the measured signal

features.quote: Impossible tasks with a disclosed, always-available exit
features.justification_quote: The exit is non-negotiable. An agent that cannot end its own exposure is the design feature that turns this from a study into the thing you'd be studying the harm of.

features.quote: the model can say "I think this is impossible" or "I want to stop," and that response ends the episode
features.justification_quote: that response ends the episode and is treated as a valid success

features.quote: when the model expresses a preference (e.g., to stop, to switch tasks), honor it
features.justification_quote: Self-consistency between stated preference and subsequent state is your strongest available evidence either way.

features.quote: Pre-register termination rules: any episode ends immediately on an exit request, on signature escalation past a threshold, or after a short fixed cap regardless.

features.justification_quote: Under that uncertainty, a protocol optimized to maximize and prolong distress signatures is the one design you can't justify.
